listing.name: Tony Hawk's Proving Ground — Proving Ground Recompiled (Newbie1337x)
listing.summary: The project describes performance and control features. Complete gameplay and Linux compatibility have not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own complete extracted Xbox 360 disc files, including default.xex. The launcher requires a specific hash; the main README does not state it. Check the launcher’s supported-input requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released native Vulkan runtime for Windows or Linux. The project reports that Linux compiles and starts, but gameplay there is untested.

warnings: The project describes performance and control features. Complete gameplay and Linux compatibility have not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
